card.name: Drug interaction exposure wording (CYP3A4)
card.fires_on: Small words and word pieces inside drug-interaction passages on CYP enzymes, P-gp, and changes in drug exposure (AUC, Cmax). Typical spots are 'the' after 'increased', the 'C' in CYP2D6, and 'active' before 'metabolites'.

modes.label: Linking words in exposure changes
modes.description: Words like 'the' or 'active' right after an increase or decrease in exposure of a drug.

modes.description: Pieces of CYP or P-gp names, such as the 'C' of CYP2D6 or the 'A' in CYP3A4.
